name: context-handoff
description: Remind after repeated context compaction and hand work to a fresh Codex task on confirmation.

interface.shortDescription: Reliable handoff after long Codex conversations.
interface.longDescription: Reminds after the fourth context compaction and each one after it. Older tasks can import structured compaction events when the host provides a readable transcript. Reply with 确认交接 to prepare handoff notes and a prompt for a fresh conversation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me configure or perform a context handoff.
